---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for the project
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the proposed feature is.

## Motivation & Problem Statement
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve or what workflow does it optimize?

## Proposed Implementation
Describe how you envision this feature being implemented:
- Modules or files affected
- New dependencies (if any)
- API contracts or interface signatures

## Expected Outcome
What should happen after this feature is implemented? How will it be verified?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, architectural diagrams, or research references here.
